newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse closes slightly up, volume rises.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse closes slightly up, volume rises.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed up 0.32 percent in increased volume, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 594.40 from 592.51 on Friday.
Trade volume was 1.248 million dinars against 1.126 million dinars.
Coke bottler SFBT was up 3.34 dinars to 114.93 dinars. Banque Nationale Agricole gained 1.84 dinars to 32.99 dinars.
Retail stores Monoprix gained 0.6 dinar to 34.1 dinars.
Chemical firm ICF was down 1.96 dinar to 63.54 dinars and detergents firm SPCD eased 1.11 dinar to 36 dinars.
